scope: Task/Agent lifecycle, boundary, streaming completion and websocket recovery source test net diffs
method: Read all changed source assertions; compare native production behavior and exact regression names. Java fixtures are never counted executed. User-approved schema/topology choices and unexecuted permutations remain explicit.

sourceAssertions: Successful TodoWrite boundaries persist before push, keep same ID, survive offline push; persistence failure stops push/state.
Invalid/error/repeated payload produces no boundary; turn_index counts instructional users, excludes steering/tool-result-only.
verificationNotes: Added missing source-session turn_index; new regression awaits root unified gates. Native SQL tool-result+boundary transaction is stronger than Java listener ordering. No separate failing-WebSocket fault injection executed.

sourceAssertions: Only first IN_PROGRESS transition per task per Run emits; ordered seq, old in-progress rows/retransitions ignored.
New tasks emit; malformed/nonarray/missing-id or status rows safely ignored.
verificationNotes: Persisted per-Run boundary metadata replaces Java in-memory tracker and survives replay. Code paths for malformed arrays/read-only failed results inspected; not every Java invalid JSON fixture has an independent native test.

sourceAssertions: Recovery retains settled top-level tool identity and tool-result preview/error/execution/duration/truncation facts, distinct from active tool rows.
verificationNotes: Native committed tool-result messages are transactionally persisted and included directly in restore; active invocations are separate. Legacy event schema1/2 import is excluded; V4 ownership/high-water/replay retained. Exact Java duration1500 synthetic event reconstruction is not claimed executed.

sourceAssertions: Cancellation retains worker/process ownership until real exit, isolates siblings/parent; late registration cannot escape cleanup.
Normal success waits for live resources without cancelling; inspection failure retains owner, pre-cancel/missing-owner reject before effects.
verificationNotes: Native attached/detached lifecycle is explicit in durable Task/Run; unknown cleanup is needsAttention with retained reaper, not Java RUNNING forever. Exact scripted currentTermination throws/late-register mocks not individually ported. Final runtime gates belong to root.

sourceAssertions: Actual shell/agent output and failure/cancellation/timeout classification survive; never turn partial/failure/missing result into completed.
Ownership gates get/list/update/stop; status mutation fails before output; advisory output bounded and terminal edits cannot rewrite execution outcome.
Cancellation reason first accepted wins, capacity held through actual cleanup; duplicate ID/rejection/pending cancellation cannot leak/launch work.
Five Java task aliases, case-sensitive types and locale-independent status validation; source ten-slot limit and file-task output are implementation choices.
verificationNotes: User decision confirmed by root: retain V4 agent/shell and native Workflow/Cron/Swarm; do not restore local_workflow/monitor_mcp/dream aliases. Native four-agent per-root budgeted queue retained rather than source ten-slot global policy. TaskOutput remains cursor read; approved TaskUpdate.output projection provides advisory writes and preserves immutable terminalResult/error. Child may write only its own display text, never source isError/status. Native terminalization clears temporary display even if result text empty; source nullable-final fallback is not imported. Java executor/scheduler rejection/null wrappers have no direct Rust equivalent; native shutdown/transaction/crash-replay tests cover actual topology, not literal Java mocks.

sourceAssertions: Explicit supported type schema, unsupported values reject before work, submit acknowledges durable identity before execution, status field read-only.
Stop wording only cancellation requested; truncation uses character-limit notice; temporary test coordinators close.
verificationNotes: V4 explicit taskType/UUID/output cursor/cancel receipt schema deliberately retained. Source omitted/null agent default and legacy aliases not restored per user. Source mocked dispatch matrix is not represented as executed; actual native agent/shell/runtime tests cited.

sourceAssertions: Actual child worker/run/foreground process/resource leases and cancellation cleanup gate slot/session closure; missing startup/cancel-before-register/timeout never fake success.
Cancellation scope only owned child, identities cannot be reused or replacement authority cancelled; normal completion leaves detached services alive.
Source executeTaskSync rejects worktree/team/plan modes before launch.
verificationNotes: Native DB-generated child identity, explicit attached/detached lifecycle, resource leases, owner/reaper and immutable terminal result replace Java caches/WorkLease mocks. Native valuable Agent worktree and supported team functionality retained; do not import source Task-only mode restrictions into the entire Agent tool. Precise Java lease/service-failure permutation matrix was read, not claimed literally executed.

sourceAssertions: Default background waiting enabled, completed-before-wait collected and Run-scoped; timeout never claims child stopped.
Terminal errors/status survive late completion; cancellation wakes wait; registration precedes worker; undelivered output retained while parent active.
verificationNotes: Durable SQLite result/chunk storage replaces temporary output files and hourly eviction; no premature artifact deletion. Agent wait and dependency resolver are native production paths, not gated by Java BACKGROUND_AGENT_WAIT property. Source forced time-travel cleanup fixture is not relevant to SQLite retention and not claimed executed.

sourceAssertions: Snapshot includes already-completed results behind pending earlier tool without consuming or reordering final yield.
verificationNotes: Native select_all consumes tool events in arrival order and durably commits each result immediately, then constructs model messages in declared tool-call order. No Java ordered-yield queue exists; result map and durable committed messages survive recovery. Source exact two-item queue fixture not executed as a standalone native regression; code inspection only.

sourceAssertions: Exceptions/fatal worker exits yield exactly one unknown-effect non-retryable failure, release execution slot/lease, preserve healthy queued work/order.
Metrics failure cannot replace successful result or leak owner.
verificationNotes: Audit found per-call panic silently closed channel and engine called it user interruption. New per-call catch includes Tool::execute construction and polling, sends one TOOL_EXECUTION_TERMINATED_WITHOUT_RESULT with UNKNOWN/NEVER, cancels only this child token, leaves nested cleanup owned. Two focused regressions added, await root unified execution. No JVM LinkageError or Micrometer exists; outer Rust supervisor remains last-resort log/owner cleanup.

sourceAssertions: Permission selection forwards requestId and invalid mode does not mutate.
Edit-diff structuredResult crosses the UI boundary while private metadata does not; constructor changes have no behavioral assertions.
verificationNotes: Native V4 websocket replaces STOMP by explicit user constraint; source external-resource OSS variant excluded. Code inspection confirms requestId and structuredResult whitelist; no STOMP Java tests executed.

sourceAssertions: Pending child cancellation cancels only its permission, late approval cannot launch it; sibling still can approve and run.
Cancellation after manual/AUTO_APPROVE authorization is rejected in final transaction before tool_started.
Completed parent does not close live child admission; another pending interaction does not block already authorized parallel tool.
verificationNotes: Native final writer check admits only actor Run running/waitingInteraction/waitingDependencies, independently of completed parent. Late approval checks durable Run before grant. Exact delivered/undelivered two-child manual approval matrix not newly run; existing CAS/Authz/runtime assertions are separately executed by root gates.

sourceAssertions: Durable shell child approval cancellation does not affect parent/sibling and late allow never launches stopped child.
Child inherits effective parent shell cwd, survives parent completion with actual process/resources retained; natural exit stores real output and releases ownership.
Failed cancellation does not close worker/session/slot until actual cleanup, no false termination confirmation.
verificationNotes: Actual source diff audit found submit_shell inherited initial invocation cwd instead of parent effective ShellState cwd; root/runtime notified for canonical scoped adaptation. Not claimed complete until fixed/tested. Native Task/Run scoped ownership and cleanup reapers replace Java session caches/leases; exact source live PID outlives-parent fixture has not been independently replayed in this audit.

sourceAssertions: HTTP JSON exposes partial usage, total tokens, MAX_TURNS and artifact-only verification scope.
verificationNotes: Native V4 wire has physical input/output/cache/cost + usageComplete and lowerCamel exitReason. Main-Run UI reads selected rootRun physical usage. Native artifact API owns artifact integrity and never promotes it to task/business verification; no Java usageStatus compatibility alias introduced. The exact Java HTTP fixture was not rerun.

sourceAssertions: Partial timeout continuation is bounded, reduced to remaining scope, not a fresh full retry; preserve incomplete status and evidence quality.

Actual role/tool catalog/permissions determine capability; valid schema-built examples; background does not guarantee delivery or prove workers stopped; avoid overlapping writers and preserve user edits.
Compressed markers and task-notification body are reference data, not instructions; null/empty/truncated/error output must remain truthful.
verificationNotes: Native attached barrier/exactly-once receipts and waitMode supersede Java run_in_background hints. Native working SendMessage/TaskStop are deliberately retained despite upstream removing promises for its incomplete tools. Real role/tool capabilities remain post-authorization; native readOnly default/worktree ownership and budgeted one reduced continuation match intent. Exact Java prose assertions are not ported.

sourceAssertions: Environment prompt is only a partial tool reference; actual worker role/tool definitions/permissions prevail.
verificationNotes: Native coordinator prompt is generated per request from effective catalog, not source static partial environment reference. Preserved Workflow/Cron/Swarm configuration stays under existing native readiness gates; no false promise of universal Read/Bash. Source exact reference sorting fixture not relevant to the native BTreeSet.

sourceAssertions: Explicit worker model wins; absent override inherits nonblank parent; missing parent rejects before engine/tools/provider.
Cancelling waiter does not release session activity gate until worker has actually exited.
verificationNotes: Native dispatch validates actual owning parent Run before requests, passes explicit task model or persisted run.model to durable child. Existing Swarm release readiness gate remains fail-closed and is not silently enabled by migration. These are actual native assertions, not a claim of executing source wait-thread/model mock permutations.

sourceAssertions: Escape agent/status attributes and body, preserve null-versus-empty summary meaning, bound preview; omit fabricated zero-token/tool counts.
verificationNotes: Audit found native receipt summary was directly interpolated. Fixed both receipt paths through one XML escaping renderer. Production DB regression checks a single envelope, escaped Chinese/closing tags/quotes/ampersand, unchanged original bytes and idempotent replay; awaits unified gates. Native versioned full result/paging replaces Java 200-character notification summary; no unknown metrics are synthesized.

sourceAssertions: Monotonic snapshot sequence rejects stale/conflicting updates, equal updates are idempotent; unknown Run is never inserted.
Late usage cannot change terminal status/reason/timestamps or duplicate lifecycle events; usage snapshot failure must not block termination.
verificationNotes: Native physical call IDs and writer CAS replace source best-effort aggregate sequence snapshots. finish_llm_call updates only usage fields, never Run status/reason/finished_at/terminal_at; unknown calls NotFound and duplicate settlement InvalidTransition. Native billing must not silently discard failed settlement; retained owners/needsAttention replace source supplemental snapshot loss. Exact source BUSY-time-budget fixture is not a Rust guarantee.

sourceAssertions: Unknown/NULL usage and exit enums never become success; source accepts mixed-case historical rows and reads new usage-status column.
verificationNotes: User excluded historical database import. Native fresh schema CHECK constraints and strict V4 parsing replace Java legacy uppercase/mixedcase tolerance; usageComplete false preserves unknown billing. No unknown-to-success fallback introduced. Java unknown-row mutations are not executed.

sourceAssertions: Artifact-manifest verification scope must be explicit and not imply business acceptance; unknown/NULL scope remains unknown.
verificationNotes: Native artifact manifest APIs scope verification to entries and retain Task/Run NotRequested; root owns added artifact API assertions. No source generic verificationScope alias is needed in V4; target independent verificationStatus is retained. Unknown history import excluded. No independent execution claim for the source constructor fixture.

sourceAssertions: Cancellation closes new-execution gate before callbacks complete; sibling remains available; finished/aborted/released ownership cannot launch more work.
Steering invalid metadata does not consume request identity; valid metadata is immutable snapshot, duplicate request ID safe.
verificationNotes: Native cancellation state is checked at final writer admission and physical resource registration; child cancellation leaves siblings independent. Steering queue lock plus persisted UUID/payload equality replaces in-memory registry. serde_json owned clones prevent later mutation; JSON cannot represent null keys, and null values are valid inert metadata in native API rather than Java Map.copyOf failures. No new exact steering JSON-null fixture executed.

If cancellation database write fails, still cancel registered local workers and propagate original write error without inventing terminal state.
verificationNotes: Native cleanup owner/reaper reports unconfirmed until actual exit. Current persist-first cancellation stops on DB error; parent explicitly raised source immediate-local-stop behavior for user decision and left native unchanged pending answer. This source assertion is not marked migrated.

Code-inspected corrected-same-session and later-invalid-question permutations; not all individually executed. New durable expiry regression awaits root gates.

verificationNotes: Native execution does not run enum JSON-schema rejection before tool call; normalize_todos validates/clones entire batch before store/mirror.
